description.value:
Monowire (doesn't count against its enhancements). Spend an Action and 4 hours loading one quickhack of DV8 or less into the wire (unavailable for normal hacking meanwhile). With Combat Software (Data Tunnelling), once per fight give up your Move Action to charge it; your next Action must be a ROF1 Monowire attack. A hit deals +1d6 (3d6) and counts as a direct connection to the target's Neuroport; a Netrunner gets one free NET Action that Turn, using only the loaded quickhack.

Enhances: Monowire

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware
